controls.heading: Edit Individual Elements
controls.description: Hide or Show individual elements of a post or edit their options

controls.label: Randomize
controls.labelDescription: This will disable “By date” and “By rating” and randomly choose among the filtered reviews

controls.heading: Only show reviews containing
controls.placeholder: Add words here to only show posts containing these words

controls.heading: Do not show reviews containing
controls.placeholder: Add words here to hide any posts containing these words

options.label: Allow List
options.description: Hides posts by default so you can select the ones you want to show

options.label: Block List
options.description: Show all posts by default so you can select the ones you want to hide

controls.noticeHeading: You can only view and filter through the last 100 reviews
controls.noticeText: Due to platform API limitations, we cannot store and provide you with a complete repository of your reviews.

language_section.heading: Language
language_section.description: Change language of what posts are displayed in

controls.noticeText: Only Google supports different languages. Reviews from other providers will still show up in English or the language they were submitted in.

controls.heading: TrustPilot Language
controls.description: Change the language of the reviews from TrustPilot. This will only affect the reviews from TrustPilot.
